items.en: The world's crust is squeezed and cracked by the powerful tidal forces of Salus, causing regular quakes and eruptions. Abundant geysers of volatile gases maintain a thin, toxic atmosphere and combine with iron compounds to give Cruor its sanguine colouration. Tracked rigs onced roamed the more stable surface provinces, ripping out rare or merely convenient ores for export while corroding ruins of machines can occasionally be seen amidst the scars of strip-mining. The paramilitary guards of the former mobile labor-camps have gone bandit, attacking any who approach the surface for supplies - or escape.

Volturn was envisioned as a planet of agriculture and leisure to service the now annihilated capital city-moon, Opis. Refugees from the First Askonia Crisis have swelled the population of Volturn many-fold, surpassing even the numbers of Sindria and filling the floating arcologies, resort-cruisers, and terraforming barges with makeshift housing. An economy of light industry and aquaculture prevails, many products having been derived from the processing of sea-life genetically modified to flourish in the world-ocean. Achilles Andrada has transferred the seat of his government here after the destruction of Sindria. It is a demoralized garrison-state as hollow in purpose as its name; perhaps its lackadaisical enforcement enables its uneasy rule over a world of stinking algae farms and floating slums, the hotbeds of resistance movements, esoteric cults, and criminal syndicates.

Far from Askonia's primary, Umbra is a frozen world of methane and ammonia where water-ice is like rock and may be found in mountainous outcroppings and boulders. A thin atmosphere of volatiles is formed on the starward side of the planet only to freeze again on the dark side. Most craters are filled in over time as this "snow" is deposited. There is some mining of heavier materials from the poor, rocky mantle buried many kilometers beneath the glacial crust. Habitats are burrowed deeply; life on Umbra is harsh and few would willingly choose to live here permanently. A trickle of well-paid out-of-system contract workers bring much-needed expertise.

Increases the damage taken by the target ship. Generates a large amount of flux when used.

Too small to force major factions to recognize its claim over the entire Disk, Nova Maxios nonetheless considers itself the successor-polity to the Maxios Charter.

Traffic control enforced by the small militia-navy is firm but polite. Independent spacers are welcomed as cousins in the admittedly crude hulls and concourses of Nova Maxios.

Populated mostly by retired pirates, exiled radicals, and wealthier refugees, it is widely known that cargo containers have their IDs wiped and re-tagged here so that they may be safely re-circulated into the legitimate economy of the Core Worlds.

The cocktail bar "Level 25" is said to have the finest drinks in the local volume.

Gleaming transports bring Tri-Tach executives here to swindle metals and raw chemicals from the locals who receive, in turn, the usual suite of recreational and performance-enhancing 'medicines'. 

The Tri-Tachyon Quality Guarantee is law here - so long as you ensure prompt subscription payment on the gadgets, goods, tools, and life support provided by the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, you can count on receiving 'Top Treatment, The Tri-Tachyon Way!'.

The primary reactors and all valuable industrial components have been stripped - and hastily, judging by the extensive secondary damage. Passive back-up systems were crippled by the process and the station too far from the primary to receive enough energy to maintain life support. A minor warning blip on your nav computer informs you that the orbit of the station is decaying and that it will burn up in the atmosphere of Telepylus within five hundred cycles.
Docking with the station is not advisable.

Since the First Askonia Crisis, Nortia's mining and refining centers have grown sprawling, tumorous rockfoam suburbs; here following mining tunnels beneath the surface, there bubbling up comm-arrays, solar collectors, and pressure domes. Since the occupation of Nortia after the Second Askonia Crisis, the Charterist resistance which once operated the civil administration has been destroyed; those not arrested have been driven underground. The new regime is a highly militarized Sindrian Diktat administration forced to extend its limited deployments with advanced drones and surveillance technology purchased from Tri-Tachyon subsidiaries.

Since the Crisis, Nortia's mining and refining centers have grown sprawling, tumorous rockfoam suburbs; here following mining tunnels beneath the surface, there bubbling up comm-arrays, solar collectors, and pressure domes. Civil governance is carried out by a triad of private military corporations with strong connections to the Tri-Tachyon executive class. Now subject to sophisticated surveillence apparatus and a small, but drone-enhanced occupying force, the local Charterists simmer in post-uprising confusion while the Hegemony diplomats and spies have fled the planet entirely.

After the first Crisis, Nortia's mining and refining centers have grown sprawling, tumorous rockfoam suburbs; here following mining tunnels beneath the surface, there bubbling up comm-arrays, solar collectors, and pressure domes. Civil governance is carried out by an uneasy truce between several factions of former resistance factions and pirates gangs, though the distinction becomes less clear every cycle. They all do their best not to offend the cartel of independent smugglers which keeps the economy afloat, though out-of-system organized crime has taken an increasing share since the withdrawal of the Hegemony diplomatic (and intelligence) presence.

After the first Crisis, Nortia's mining and refining centers have grown sprawling, tumorous rockfoam suburbs; here following mining tunnels beneath the surface, there bubbling up comm-arrays, solar collectors, and pressure domes. Civil governance is carried out by a successor polity formed from a core of former Charterist resistance leaders backed by old money from the Opis diaspora. Intervention by the Hegemony's Strategic Council has been light in consideration of a history of Charterist cooperation with Hegemony special operations.

After the first Crisis, Nortia's mining and refining centers have grown sprawling, tumorous rockfoam suburbs; here following mining tunnels beneath the surface, there bubbling up comm-arrays, solar collectors, and pressure domes. Civil governance is carried out by a successor polity formed from a core of former Charterist resistance leaders backed by Gens Kato capital. Indeed, provisional membership in the Persean League has already been approved with Gens Kato's backing in the All-League Council.

Athulf is traditionally considered a personal possession of whoever happens to be the King of Fikenhild, and offers important income for a King who is not otherwise wealthy. Court dress is extravagant and the noblesse oblige of kingship is demanding. The subjects of Athulf also form an important core of support. Treated well, they offer a strong voting block to the sitting King. But when strikes and riots ravage the rich mines of Athulf, it is understood to be a clear sign that Westernesse shall soon choose a new King.
